quotes.text: Faith without hope, instead of yielding joy and satisfaction, would be the source of misery and woe. What joy or consolation will a belief in the existence of God or in the atonement of Christ for the sins of the world be to a man, if he has no hope of mercy from and acceptance with God, or an interest in the sacrificial work of redemption thus wrought out ? None whatever ; for a hopeless faith…
